manufacture to customer drawings for OEM pump/valve/compressor makers

win contract-machining orders and long-term subcontract relationships with pump/valve/compressor OEMs
fulfil across agriculture, energy, water infrastructure, and industrial end-markets
reorder on repeat OEM production runs
